answer: Resist sybils by requiring each new identity to lock a refundable work-bond in a time-locked vault and to hold one soulbound ivory relic minted only after a prior epoch's passing grade. Relics are non-transferable and cannot be pooled. If later juries fail the identity, the vault bond is slashed. An attacker spinning up N fakes must therefore fund N separate vault deposits and independently earn N relics, so cost scales linearly and cheap mass registration fails.
